dialog.about.title: About yacr
dialog.about.subtitle: Cross-platform open-source CAD
dialog.about.intro: yacr is a cross-platform open-source CAD project: a shared Rust core handles DWG/DXF documents, geometry and rendering; React + Tauri provides the UI; wgpu renders the drawing. It targets Linux, Windows, macOS, Android and the web with one document and rendering pipeline. The project is still in early development with no shippable release; Linux/Wayland is the primary development target with the strongest support; the Android APK has been sideloaded and run by the maintainer, and the Windows/macOS hosts are real but their runtime acceptance is still pending.

layers.off.hint: Turned off: it is hidden in this session through the same visibility path a frozen layer uses. Press to turn it back on.
layers.frozen.hint: Frozen: it is hidden in this session through the same visibility path an off layer uses; freezing's own rules are not implemented. Press to unfreeze it.
layers.locked.hint: Locked: objects on this layer cannot be created, changed or deleted. They can still be selected, and making a locked layer current is not refused yet. Press to unlock it.
layers.plottable.hint: Plottable: the flag is stored in the drawing, but plotting does not read it yet, so nothing else changes yet. Press to mark the layer as not plotted.
layers.no_plot.hint: Marked as not plotted: the flag is stored in the drawing, but plotting does not read it yet. Press to mark the layer plottable again.
layers.marks_more.hint: This layer has more states set than the row shows. Open the layer attributes to see and change them all.
layers.attributes.hint: Off and frozen both hide the layer in this session. Locked refuses creating, changing or deleting objects on the layer; the plot flag is stored but plotting does not read it yet. Linetype, lineweight and transparency are shown as the drawing stores them; they cannot be changed here.
layers.color.hint: Choosing a swatch stores an index color (aci:N); the value field takes a true color (#RRGGBB). A layer cannot be by-layer or by-block: there is no layer above it. Objects drawn by layer show the new color; objects imported with an explicit color keep it.
layers.color.marker: Layer color not reported: this dot is a marker derived from the layer name
point.display.mode.hint: PDMODE takes one number: 0 dot, 1 nothing, 2 plus, 3 cross, 4 vertical tick; 32/64 add a surrounding circle or square (96 requests both), drawn as fixed-segment line approximations (a 16-chord ring and a 4-segment square) at the marker half extent — that proportion is this build's choice, not verified against AutoCAD. The value is stored in the drawing, so it survives saving and is replaced when another drawing is opened. The change cannot be undone.
point.display.size.hint: PDSIZE takes one number: positive is an absolute size in drawing units, 0 sizes the marker from the viewport, negative is a percentage of the viewport height. The value is stored in the drawing, so it survives saving and is replaced when another drawing is opened. The change cannot be undone.

draw.kind.xline.hint: Two points define a finite segment along the construction line, clipped to the model bounds; no infinite geometry is created.
draw.kind.ray.hint: An origin and a through point define a finite segment along the ray, clipped to the model bounds; no infinite geometry is created.
draw.kind.overkill.hint: Select at least two objects; OVERKILL v1 deletes exact duplicates only (same space, layer and geometry).
draw.kind.oops.hint: Restores the objects removed by the last ERASE (ERASE-only v1; no selection needed).
draw.kind.reverse.hint: Select at least one LINE, polyline or spline; REVERSE flips its vertex/direction order in one step.
draw.kind.pedit.hint: Select exactly one model-space polyline, then type the option: {command} implements the v1 subset CLOSE, OPEN or REVERSE (C, O, R). Join, Width/Halfwidth, Fit, Spline, Decurve, Ltype gen, Undo, Multiple and Edit vertex are not implemented.
draw.kind.chamfer_polyline.hint: Needs exactly one selected open polyline of straight segments in the +Z plane: {command} chamfers every interior corner with the current chamfer distances, A along the incoming segment and B along the outgoing one. A closed polyline, an arc segment, fewer than three vertices, a vertex with no real corner, both distances set to 0 and a distance that does not fit are refused.
draw.kind.fillet_polyline.hint: Needs exactly one selected open polyline of straight segments in the +Z plane: {command} rounds every interior corner with the current fillet radius, which must be greater than 0. A closed polyline, an arc segment, fewer than three vertices, a vertex with no real corner and a radius that does not fit are refused; the radius is never reduced automatically.
draw.kind.dimspace.hint: Select at least two linear dimensions: the first is the base and the rest move to equal automatic rows at the base style's DIMDLI. v1 is model-space linear dimensions only, always uses automatic spacing (no value prompt) and does not re-associate dimensions (no associative reflow)
draw.kind.gradient.hint: Select at least one closed boundary (a circle, a full ellipse, a closed polyline, or LINE/ARC edges forming a closed loop) on the +Z plane, then run {command}: it creates one hatch with the session gradient fill (two-colour linear by default) in one undo step. There is no live preview, no -GRADIENT option prompt and no .pat handling.
draw.kind.hatchedit.hint: Select exactly one model-space hatch, then type the option: {command} implements ANGLE <degrees>, SCALE <factor>, SOLID and GRADIENT. Pattern name, Color, Properties, Draw order, Add/Remove boundaries and associativity are not implemented.
draw.kind.hatchgenerateboundary.hint: Select at least one hatch; HATCHGENERATEBOUNDARY creates one non-associative closed polyline per hatch loop (including inner islands) on the hatch's own layer and space.
draw.kind.hatchtoback.hint: HATCHTOBACK sends every model-space hatch behind all other objects in one undo step; paper-space and block hatches are not reordered.
draw.kind.boundary.hint: Pick a point inside a closed boundary (circle, full ellipse, or closed polyline); BOUNDARY creates one closed, non-associative polyline per discovered loop (including nested islands) on the active layer and keeps the source objects. The -BOUNDARY options (boundary set, island detection off, region output, object type) are not implemented.
draw.kind.texttofront.hint: Select at least one object; TEXTTOFRONT moves the selected text, multileaders and dimensions in front of every other model-space object by rewriting their draw order in one undo step. Other selected objects are skipped with a diagnostic, paper-space/block draw order is not reordered, and the all-text-in-drawing form is not implemented.
draw.kind.revcloud.hint: Select one closed straight-segment polyline; REVCLOUD replaces each edge with one outward arc (Object mode v1).
draw.kind.matchprop.hint: Needs at least two selected objects: {command} copies the display properties of the first selected object to the other selected ones
draw.kind.join.hint: Needs at least two selected objects: {command} merges collinear lines (or arcs sharing a center and radius) into one
draw.kind.selectsimilar.hint: Select at least one object; SELECTSIMILAR adds every visible model-space object of the same type.
draw.kind.breakatpoint.hint: Pick the object, then the break point (projected onto it); LINE, ARC and open polylines only.
draw.kind.list.hint: Select at least one object; LIST reports each selected object's space, layer, display properties and geometry parameters on the command line (this build does not model thickness or extrusion).
draw.kind.status.hint: STATUS reports drawing statistics, modes and the model-space extent; this build does not track creation/edit time, memory, drawing limits or the base point.
draw.kind.fs.hint: Select exactly one model-space seed object; FS adds every visible object directly touching it to the selection (an Express tool, command-line only; default FSMODE=OFF, with no transitive chain).
draw.kind.wipeout.hint: Pick boundary points one by one (at least 3), then press Enter to create the closed polygon mask. v1 has no frame model (no Frames ON/OFF or display-not-plot), no Polyline/Erase Polyline option, and does not reject self-intersections; picking an existing wipeout is not supported.
draw.kind.polygon_circumscribed.hint: Pick the centre, then a point on the inscribed (tangent) circle: the picked direction is the midpoint of the first edge and the apothem equals that radius, so the vertex radius is R = r / cos(π/n) with n from the session POLYSIDES value (3–1024). The Edge construction and a numeric-radius orientation are not implemented.

status.tool_parameter.hatch_gradient_kin: Linear runs one way along the gradient angle; Spherical ramps outward from the centre of the boundary (on an ordinary rectangular or circular boundary it fills over the whole boundary extent, so it reads flat or elliptical rather than truly radial); it applies while the pattern type is 3 (gradient)
status.tool_parameter.hatch_gradient_ang: Direction of the gradient in degrees, the same unit as the hatch angle and never wrapped; it applies while the pattern type is 3 (gradient)

status.tool_parameter.hatch_spacing.hint: Distance between pattern lines; greater than 0; doubles as HPSCALE for a predefined pattern; a solid or gradient fill does not use it
status.tool_parameter.hatch_angle.hint: Pattern angle in degrees (rotates a user-defined or predefined pattern); a solid or gradient fill does not use it
status.tool_parameter.hatch_double.hint: Whether a user-defined or predefined pattern also draws the perpendicular second family; a solid or gradient fill does not use it
status.tool_parameter.text_height.hint: Text glyph height in drawing units, shared by single-line TEXT and MTEXT; must be greater than 0 (default 2.5)
status.tool_parameter.text_rotation.hint: Rotation in degrees, read once when the text is created; shared by single-line TEXT and MTEXT, default 0. Any finite angle is accepted and used exactly as entered — it is never wrapped, so -30 stays -30 and 360 is a full turn
status.tool_parameter.mtext_attachment.h: Which point of its box an MTEXT hangs from: top, middle or bottom row, each left, centre or right; default top left. status.tool_parameter.divide_segments.hi: Number of equal segments, 2 to 1024; an open curve gets N-1 interior POINTs and a closed curve gets N points including the start parameter; the curve itself is not changed
status.tool_parameter.lengthen_mode.hint: 0 Delta adds or removes a length, 1 Percent scales the current length, 2 Total sets the new length; LINE and ARC only, and the end point is the one that moves
status.tool_parameter.lengthen_value.hin: A finite, non-zero number; Percent and Total also require a value greater than 0 (Percent reads as a percentage of the current length, Total as a length)

options.help.snapSpacing: Spacing the grid snap (F9) quantises to, in drawing units.
options.help.hoverPreview: Preview the object under the pointer before selecting it.
options.help.pickboxSize: Size of the selection pickbox in pixels, 1–50.
options.help.apertureSize: Size of the object snap aperture in pixels, 1–50.
options.help.leftDragPans: Pan the 2D view by dragging with the primary button instead of drawing a selection box.
options.help.gpuBudgetPercent: Share of the graphics card's memory CAD may use, 10–100. This is a budget for drawing, not the card's total memory.
options.help.plotFormat: Format used when the drawing is plotted or published.
options.help.fontsDir: Where the drawing's fonts are read from. Chosen at start-up, not editable here.
options.help.language: Language of the interface. Applies to this window and to the main window.
options.help.wgpuBackend: Graphics backend used for drawing. Auto lets the system choose.
plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.intro: Vendor plugins decode the application-specific objects in a drawing. Only one decoder can be active at a time; plugin changes are saved immediately but take effect on the next launch.
plugins.restart: Plugin changes are saved now. They take effect the next time the app starts; the current session keeps the plugins it already loaded.
plugins.restartShort: Plugin changes apply on the next launch
plugins.installWarning: Installing runs the plugin once to check it. A plugin has the same access as the rest of the application, so only install files you trust.
plugins.uninstallConfirm: This deletes the plugin files. A restart is required.
plugins.noDiagnostics: No vendor pass has run in this session.
plugins.empty: No plugins are installed and no built-in decoder is available.
plugins.unsupported: Plugin management is not available on this carrier. The built-in decoder stays active.
plugins.errorGeneric: The plugin action could not be completed.
plugins.errorLoad: The plugin list could not be read.
plugins.errorReason: The host did not accept the change:
plugins.fileTooLarge: This file is larger than the 4 MB plugin limit.
plugins.fileType: Only .js and .mjs plugin files can be installed.

color.title: Select color
color.custom_hint: Accepts an index color (aci:1 to aci:255) or a true color (#RRGGBB).
startup.unsupported_backend.detail: This build composites the DOM/WebView above the native CAD surface, which is implemented only for native Wayland. Run yacr in a Wayland session (GDK_BACKEND=wayland); the X11 web+canvas route is explicitly deferred.
startup.webgl2_unavailable: yacr cannot create the CAD canvas in this session (WebGL2)
startup.webgl2_unavailable.detail: On X11/XWayland the CAD image is drawn through WebGL2 by the wasm CAD session inside the WebView. This session could not provide a usable WebGL2 context, so yacr refuses to start instead of showing a blank canvas. Check the graphics driver and WebKitGTK's GL support, or run in native Wayland (GDK_BACKEND=wayland).
startup.webview2_missing: yacr cannot start: the Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime is missing
startup.webview2_missing.detail: The Windows desktop UI is a WebView2 document and cannot render without the runtime. Install the WebView2 Evergreen Runtime (or point WEBVIEW2_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE_FOLDER at a Fixed Version runtime) and start yacr again.

draw.kind.torient.hint: Select Text/MText; bare TORIENT makes the rotation most readable, or type TORIENT <angle> for an absolute rotation
draw.kind.tcase.hint: Select Text/MText; TCASE applies Title case by default (upper/lower/sentence/toggle are typed modes)
draw.kind.tcase.title: Title Case
draw.kind.txt2mtxt.hint: Select one or more Text/MText objects; TXT2MTXT joins them into one MTEXT. The settings dialog and uniform line spacing are not implemented
draw.kind.justifytext.hint: Select one or more Text/MText objects, then type JUSTIFYTEXT <H> <V> (LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT and BASELINE/BOTTOM/MIDDLE/TOP): only the alignment changes, the position does not move. TJUST is an alias; non-text objects are skipped and reported
draw.kind.tscale.hint: Select Text/MText, then type TSCALE <positive factor> to scale the glyph height and the MTEXT wrap width (the same rule as SCALETEXT), in one undo step
draw.kind.textalign.hint: Select at least two Text/MText objects, then type TEXTALIGN LEFT|RIGHT|CENTER|TOP|MIDDLE|BOTTOM to align them to a common edge or centre. Extents are estimated (height x character count) and rotation is ignored
draw.kind.tcount.hint: Select Text/MText, then type TCOUNT <start> <step> [prefix] [suffix] to number them top-to-bottom, left-to-right. AutoCAD's per-item dialog modes are not implemented
draw.kind.tcircle.hint: Select Text/MText, then type TCIRCLE CIRCLE|RECTANGLE to draw a closed boundary from the estimated text extents and keep the text. There is no associativity
draw.kind.textmask.hint: Select Text/MText; TEXTMASK inserts an independent AcDbWipeout mask behind the estimated text extents (no association model; the extents are an estimate)
draw.kind.textunmask.hint: Select text and masks (or masks only); TEXTUNMASK deletes the selected masks that lie inside the estimated text extents. It cannot prove a mask came from TEXTMASK
tool.prompt.scaletext.select_text: Select one or more Text or MText objects to scale
tool.prompt.scaletext.ready: Text selected; set the scale factor and press Enter to scale
A finite factor strictly greater than 0; it scales the glyph height of Text and MText objects (and the MText wrap width). 1.0 is a no-op and is refused by the host
status.tool_parameter.dim_rotation.hint: The DIMROTATED dimension-line angle in degrees; any finite value is accepted and is not wrapped or normalised (a negative angle rotates the other way). It only places the dimension line — the measurement is the projection of the two origins onto that direction

gpu.pulled.insufficient_vram.title: Low video memory: renderer fell back
gpu.pulled.insufficient_vram.body: The drawing's accelerated GPU copy needs more memory than is currently available, so it is drawn with the universal rendering path. Panning and zooming a large drawing may be slower.
gpu.pulled.insufficient_vram.short: Low video memory: using the fallback renderer
draw.kind.laycur.hint: Select the objects first; LAYCUR moves every selected object to the current layer.
draw.kind.laymcur.hint: Select the object first; LAYMCUR makes the first selected object's layer the current layer.
draw.kind.layfrz.hint: Select the objects first; LAYFRZ freezes the layer of every selected object in all viewports (freezing the current layer is refused).
draw.kind.laythw.hint: No selection is needed; LAYTHW thaws every frozen layer (viewport-level frozen layers and the new-viewport flag are not changed).
draw.kind.laylck.hint: Select the objects first; LAYLCK locks the layer of every selected object (the current layer may be locked too).
draw.kind.layulk.hint: Select the objects first; LAYULK unlocks the layer of every selected object.
draw.kind.setbylayer.hint: Select the objects first; SETBYLAYER resets colour, linetype and lineweight to ByLayer (transparency, materials and the other listed properties are not reset; Include blocks is not implemented).
draw.kind.laymch: Merge selection to first pick's layer (LAYMCH)
draw.kind.laymch.hint: Select at least two objects first; the first pick's layer is the destination and the rest move onto it (one transaction, one undo step).
draw.kind.laymrg.hint: Select objects first; their layers merge into the current layer and the source rows are deleted (layer-table edits are not undoable; the current layer and layer 0 cannot be sources).
draw.kind.laydel.hint: Select objects first; every model-space entity on their layers and the layer rows are deleted (paper-space/block entities are not deleted; the current layer and layer 0 are refused).
draw.kind.ssx.hint: Select one object first; SSX adds every model-space object with the same type, layer, colour, linetype and space.
draw.kind.selectcount.hint: Select one object first; SELECTCOUNT reports how many model-space objects share its type, layer, colour, linetype and space, without changing the selection.
draw.kind.hideobjects.hint: Select at least one object; HIDEOBJECTS hides it for this session only and writes no drawing data.
draw.kind.isolateobjects.hint: Select the objects to keep; ISOLATEOBJECTS hides every other model-space object for this session.
draw.kind.unisolateobjects.hint: UNISOLATEOBJECTS restores every hidden object; it needs no selection.
draw.kind.donut.hint: Type DONUT <cx> <cy> <inner> <outer>: two concentric circles on the active layer in one undo step. The centre is typed because this build has no centre pick prompt; inner 0 stores the outer circle only (reported).
draw.kind.solid.hint: Type SOLID <x,y> <x,y> <x,y> [<x,y>]: a filled triangle or quadrilateral stored as a two-triangle mesh. The outline is never drawn as an unfilled line; DXF export writes a polyface mesh, not a SOLID record.
draw.kind.helix.hint: Type HELIX <base x> <base y> <radius> <turns> <height>: a flat 2D spiral polyline. The 3D spring form (height > 0) is not implemented and is refused by name.
draw.kind.mline.hint: Type MLINE <spacing> <offset> <x1,y1> <x2,y2>: two parallel lines around the baseline at the current MLSTYLE spacing. Joins, caps and multi-segment baselines are not implemented.
draw.kind.mlstyle.hint: Type MLSTYLE LIST or MLSTYLE SET <name> <spacing>: a bounded session-only style store (16 entries) that feeds MLINE. Nothing is written to the drawing or DWG.
draw.kind.trex.hint: Select at least two objects; TREX TRIM or TREX EXTEND uses every other selected object as a boundary. There is no boundary prompt: TRIM keeps the piece containing each target's midpoint and EXTEND grows its end.
draw.kind.extrim.hint: Select the boundary first, then the crossing objects; EXTRIM trims every target at the boundary in one undo step. Boundary kinds are LINE/CIRCLE/ARC/POLYLINE; other kinds are refused by name.
draw.kind.mpedit.hint: Select one or more polylines; MPEDIT CLOSE, OPEN or REVERSE applies the PEDIT option to every selected polyline in one undo step. Non-polylines are skipped with a diagnostic.
draw.kind.draworder.hint: Select at least one model-space object; DRAWORDER FRONT/BACK moves the whole selection. ABOVE/BELOW use the first selected object as the reference and need at least one more object to move.
draw.kind.redraw.hint: Redraw refreshes the current viewport's display without moving the camera or changing the drawing.
draw.kind.redrawall.hint: Refreshes every viewport of the open drawing; the camera and the drawing are unchanged.
draw.kind.regen.hint: Advances the current viewport's regeneration stamp so derived display caches can rebuild; the drawing is not written.
draw.kind.regenall.hint: Regenerates every viewport of the open drawing; the drawing is not written.
draw.kind.view.hint: Saves, restores, lists or deletes session-only named views (at most 32, case-insensitive names). Nothing is written to the DWG; use VIEW SAVE <name>.
draw.kind.viewgo.hint: Restores a saved named view; an unknown name is refused by name.
draw.kind.viewback.hint: Restores the previous discrete view. Pans, wheel zooms and orbit drags are not recorded; an empty history changes nothing.
draw.kind.viewforward.hint: Returns to a view you stepped back from; an empty forward history changes nothing.
draw.kind.vpoint.hint: VPOINT <x> <y> <z> or TOP/BOTTOM/FRONT/BACK/LEFT/RIGHT. The vector form is a 3D observation; a zero vector is refused.
draw.kind.dimtedit.hint: Select exactly one dimension: MOVE <x> <y> sets the text position, ROTATE <degrees> its rotation, RESET restores the derived placement
draw.kind.dimedit.hint: Select at least one dimension: TEXT <override> stores the measurement text template (<> is the measurement), RESET drops it
draw.kind.dimoverride.hint: Select at least one dimension: DIMOVERRIDE <variable> <value> writes the entity style snapshot for the admitted variables only
draw.kind.qdim.hint: Select at least one straight LINE: v1 creates one aligned dimension per line at the Standard DIMDLI offset in model space
draw.kind.dimjogline.hint: Not available: the dimension domain stores no jog field, so this command refuses by name
draw.kind.dimbreak.hint: Not available: the dimension domain stores no dimension-line break, so this command refuses without trimming the dimension
draw.kind.group.hint: GROUP CREATE <name> captures the current selection into a session-only group; GROUP LIST reports the names and GROUP DELETE <name> removes one. No DWG group object is created.
draw.kind.ungroup.hint: UNGROUP <name> removes the named session-only group; every entity is retained and the drawing is not written.
draw.kind.groupedit.hint: GROUPEDIT <name> ADD|REMOVE|RENAME <arg> edits the session-only member list; no entity or database is written.
draw.kind.qleader.hint: QLEADER <arrow x,y> <landing x,y> <text> creates one MULTILEADER; the legacy LEADER/QLEADER entity is mapped to MULTILEADER.
draw.kind.leader.hint: LEADER <arrow x,y> <landing x,y> <text> creates one MULTILEADER; the legacy LEADER entity is mapped to MULTILEADER.
draw.kind.textfit.hint: TEXTFIT <target width> adjusts only the glyph height using the estimate height x character count; true width stretch is not implemented.
draw.kind.hatchsetboundary.hint: Select exactly one hatch plus closed Polyline/Circle/full Ellipse boundaries; one transaction rebuilds the hatch loops and keeps the source entities.
draw.kind.hatchsetorigin.hint: HATCHSETORIGIN <x> <y> is a named refusal: the hatch domain stores no pattern-origin field, so nothing is written.
draw.kind.xdlist.hint: XDLIST reports the selection's retained extended data; this build retains none and reports xdlist.not_retained.
